title: MCP server with read-only battery tools
goal: NERV can list FPVBuddy's MCP tools and read battery data
acceptance: A Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint over the F-005 BatteryRegistry exposes only read-only list_batteries and get_battery tools, with Italian phrasing in the model-facing tool descriptions and specs
The HTTP service binds to loopback, checks configured Host and Origin values, and documents macOS LaunchAgent installation and tailnet HTTPS through Tailscale Serve
The consumer tool table and exact NERV owner-check commands are documented; durable owner battery data remains explicitly dependent on F-016
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a small server on an existing core; the host chosen in F-009-T01 carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
